Articles 315–323 | Part XIV
Central Recruiting Agency
Tenure – 6 years / 65 years
Removal – President + Supreme Court inquiry
Independent Constitutional Body
Advisory + Recruitment functions

items: Articles 315–323 in Part XIV are frequently asked in Indian competitive exams.
Remember the tenure combination: 6 years or 65 years of age, whichever is earlier.
Removal authority lies with the President, strictly based on a Supreme Court inquiry.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Governed by Articles 315–323 under Part XIV of the Indian Constitution.
Serves as the Central Recruiting Agency for the nation.
Operates as an Independent Constitutional Body with advisory and recruitment functions.
Members have a fixed tenure of 6 years or until reaching 65 years of age.
Removal procedure involves the President and a mandatory Supreme Court inquiry.
